attacks.quote: Phones are not bad, everyone has a phone now

break.label: No link
break.why: You said "everyone has a phone now", but never showed why that means phones don't make students learn less.

hint: What would have to be true for "everyone has a phone" to mean students don't learn less?
landed: You named both of their points: "Their first point is wrong" and "bullying happens anyway".
_model_answer: Their first point says phones make us learn less. But the problem is notifications, not phones, because focus mode stops every buzz, so students keep their attention on the lesson.
